title: CHD-Bench: Diagnosing Congenital Heart Disease through Interactive Examination
abstract: arXiv:2611.33775v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diagnosis of congenital heart disease (CHD) requires understanding the spatial relationships between cardiac structures, which clinicians assess by scrolling through CT or cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) slices and rotating 3D reconstructions. Although automated methods have advanced cardiac segmentation, identifying congenital heart defects from volumetric scans remains an open challenge. The two existing approaches rely on handcrafted diagnostic rules limited to static anatomical abnormalities. We introduce CHD-Bench, the first benchmark for interactive CHD diagnosis, defining a multi-label task and evaluation protocol over 247 CT and MRI scans from three cohorts covering 38 CHD types. We also present CHD-Harness, open-source software that runs a VLM in a 3D Slicer environment through 22 tools, manages each examination, and records the resulting diagnosis and supporting views. translated_title: CHD-Bench：通过交互式检查诊断先天性心脏病
translated_abstract: 先天性心脏病（CHD）的诊断需要理解心脏结构之间的空间关系，临床医生通过滚动浏览CT或心脏磁共振成像（MRI）切片以及旋转三维重建来评估这些关系。尽管自动化方法已经推动了心脏分割技术的发展，但从体数据扫描中识别先天性心脏缺陷仍然是一个悬而未决的挑战。现有的两种方法依赖于手工制定的诊断规则，且仅局限于静态解剖异常。我们提出了CHD-Bench，这是首个用于交互式CHD诊断的基准，定义了多标签任务和评估协议，涵盖来自三个队列的247个CT和MRI扫描，覆盖38种CHD类型。我们还提出了CHD-Harness，这是一个开源软件，通过22个工具在3D Slicer环境中运行视觉语言模型（VLM），管理每次检查过程，并记录所得的诊断结果及支持性视图。我们评估了现成的医学模型、开放权重模型……（摘要未完整提供）
tldr: 提出了首个交互式先天性心脏病诊断基准CHD-Bench及配套开源软件CHD-Harness，在247个CT/MRI扫描上通过多标签任务评估视觉语言模型对38种先天性心脏病的诊断能力。
en_tdlr: Introduces CHD-Bench, the first benchmark for interactive congenital heart disease diagnosis, along with the open-source CHD-Harness software, evaluating VLMs on a multi-label task over 247 CT/MRI scans covering 38 CHD types.
